record.question:
Which of the following nets can be used to build the partial cube shown in the diagram?
<image1>
<image2>
record.solution: Nets A and D would produce cubes with holes on two edges of the same face. Net E would produce a cube with a hole in the centre of two opposite faces while net B would produce a cube with one hole on an edge and two small holes. The given partial cube has holes on two opposite edges and therefore its net will have a hole on the edge of four different faces.  Hence only net C can be used to build the required shape.
